name: Omoi...
source:
Perception of people is individual with everyone.
No one can decide what is right and what is wrong.
So, what do you think of me ...

An omnibus visual novel with the theme of "feelings".

[Translated from [url=http://www.liliumrubellum.com/product/omoi/]Official site[/url]]
